tools.evidence_kind: READ: IETF Internet-Draft text, rev -13 (reference architecture, not software)

O1.note: Framework requires a data repository fed with real-time operational data via SNMP, NETCONF, IPFIX, telemetry; no implementation exists.

O2.note: Framework says config changes can be pre-verified in the twin; it specifies no checker, so you build one.

O3.note: Names what-if analysis and performance models such as bottleneck structures; gives no traffic-aware congestion method.

O4.note: Document, not software; mentions GNS3 and EVE-NG only as example emulators for small networks.

O5.note: Cites twin-based fuzzing and resilience (what-if) testing as use cases; defines no drill mechanism.

O6.note: Only lists energy monitoring and optimization as a twinning-management topic; defines no device power-down analysis.

O7.note: Describes intent-based networking validated on the twin; abstract intents, no natural-language requirement.

O8.note: Requires historical and/or real-time data and reproducibility, meaning replay of event sequences; no mechanism defined.

M2.note: Free to read; nothing to buy or run
